package http_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	transporthttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http"
	privatehandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/readiness"
)

const readinessRouteStudentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"

func TestLearningReadinessRouteRequiresExactTeacherTokenAndReturnsNoStore(t *testing.T) {
	student := &routeReadinessStudent{snapshot: routeReadinessSnapshot()}
	graphs := &routeReadinessGraphs{}
	router := readinessRouter(true, student, graphs)
	path := "/internal/students/" + readinessRouteStudentID + "/learning-readiness"
	body := `{"schema":"learning-readiness-request.v1"}`
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name, token string
		want        int
	}{
		{name: "general token rejected", token: "general-token", want: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "practice token rejected", token: "practice-token", want: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "teacher token accepted", token: "teacher-token", want: http.StatusOK},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, bytes.NewBufferString(body))
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != testCase.want {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d want=%d body=%s", response.Code, testCase.want, response.Body.String())
			}
			if response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
				t.Fatalf("cache-control=%q", response.Header().Get("Cache-Control"))
			}
			if testCase.want == http.StatusOK {
				if strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "course_id") || strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "learning_path_id") || strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "lesson_id") {
					t.Fatalf("READY leaked prospective identity: %s", response.Body.String())
				}
				var result domain.LearningReadiness
				if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &result); err != nil || result.Schema != domain.LearningReadinessSchema || result.Goal == nil || result.Goal.Code != "programming.foundation" {
					t.Fatalf("result=%#v err=%v", result, err)
				}
			}
		})
	}
	if student.calls != 1 || graphs.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("student_calls=%d graph_calls=%d", student.calls, graphs.calls)
	}
}

func TestLearningReadinessRouteStrictBodyAndCanonicalStudentID(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		path string
		body string
	}{
		{name: "unknown field", path: readinessRouteStudentID, body: `{"schema":"learning-readiness-request.v1","goal_code":"go.backend"}`},
		{name: "trailing json", path: readinessRouteStudentID, body: `{"schema":"learning-readiness-request.v1"}{}`},
		{name: "wrong schema", path: readinessRouteStudentID, body: `{"schema":"learning-readiness-request.v2"}`},
		{name: "null expected ref", path: readinessRouteStudentID, body: `{"schema":"learning-readiness-request.v1","expected_state_ref":null}`},
		{name: "invalid expected ref", path: readinessRouteStudentID, body: `{"schema":"learning-readiness-request.v1","expected_state_ref":{"kind":"none","version":1}}`},
		{name: "noncanonical student", path: "AAAAAAAA-AAAA-4AAA-8AAA-AAAAAAAAAAAA", body: `{"schema":"learning-readiness-request.v1"}`},
		{name: "oversize", path: readinessRouteStudentID, body: `{"schema":"learning-readiness-request.v1","padding":"` + strings.Repeat("x", 17<<10) + `"}`},
	}
	for _, testCase := range tests {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			student := &routeReadinessStudent{snapshot: routeReadinessSnapshot()}
			graphs := &routeReadinessGraphs{}
			router := readinessRouter(true, student, graphs)
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/students/"+testCase.path+"/learning-readiness", bytes.NewBufferString(testCase.body))
			request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-token")
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != http.StatusUnprocessableEntity && response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
			}
			if student.calls != 0 || graphs.calls != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("student_calls=%d graph_calls=%d", student.calls, graphs.calls)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestLearningReadinessRouteFlagOffAndStaleExpectedVersion(t *testing.T) {
	student := &routeReadinessStudent{snapshot: routeReadinessSnapshot()}
	graphs := &routeReadinessGraphs{}
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/students/"+readinessRouteStudentID+"/learning-readiness", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"schema":"learning-readiness-request.v1"}`))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	readinessRouter(false, student, graphs).ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusServiceUnavailable || student.calls != 0 || graphs.calls != 0 || !strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "learning_readiness_disabled") {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s student_calls=%d graph_calls=%d", response.Code, response.Body.String(), student.calls, graphs.calls)
	}

	student = &routeReadinessStudent{snapshot: routeReadinessSnapshot()}
	graphs = &routeReadinessGraphs{}
	request = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/students/"+readinessRouteStudentID+"/learning-readiness", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"schema":"learning-readiness-request.v1","expected_state_ref":{"kind":"accepted_draft","version":3}}`))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-token")
	response = httptest.NewRecorder()
	readinessRouter(true, student, graphs).ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusConflict || student.calls != 1 || graphs.calls != 0 || !strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "student_state_changed") {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s student_calls=%d graph_calls=%d", response.Code, response.Body.String(), student.calls, graphs.calls)
	}
}

func TestLearningReadinessRouteMapsRepositoryGraphValidationToInvalidGraph(t *testing.T) {
	student := &routeReadinessStudent{snapshot: routeReadinessSnapshot()}
	graphs := &routeReadinessGraphs{err: domain.ErrValidation}
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/students/"+readinessRouteStudentID+"/learning-readiness", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"schema":"learning-readiness-request.v1"}`))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "teacher-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	readinessRouter(true, student, graphs).ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusInternalServerError || response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" ||
		!strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "published_graph_invalid") || student.calls != 1 || graphs.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d cache=%q body=%s", response.Code, response.Header().Get("Cache-Control"), response.Body.String())
	}
}

func readinessRouter(enabled bool, student *routeReadinessStudent, graphs *routeReadinessGraphs) http.Handler {
	return transporthttp.NewRouter(transporthttp.RouterDependencies{
		InternalToken: "general-token", TeacherToken: "teacher-token", PracticeToken: "practice-token",
		LearningReadiness: privatehandlers.LearningReadinessHandler{Resolve: readiness.Resolver{
			Enabled: enabled, Students: student, Graphs: graphs,
		}},
	})
}

func routeReadinessSnapshot() domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot {
	return domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{
		Schema: domain.StudentReadinessSnapshotSchema, StudentID: readinessRouteStudentID,
		StateRef:       domain.StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4},
		LearningIntent: &domain.StudentReadinessLearningIntent{Code: "learn_programming", Source: "onboarding_goal_code.v1", Provenance: "accepted_student_draft"},
		Profile: domain.StudentReadinessProfile{
			DirectionCode: "undecided", SelfAssessedExperience: "beginner",
			KnownStacks:       domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered},
			DesiredStacks:     domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered},
			PreferredLanguage: &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_ui"},
			ContentLanguage:   &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_ui", Source: "preferred_language"},
		},
	}
}

type routeReadinessStudent struct {
	snapshot domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot
	calls    int
}

func (stub *routeReadinessStudent) GetPlanningReadiness(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot, error) {
	stub.calls++
	return stub.snapshot, nil
}

type routeReadinessGraphs struct {
	calls int
	err   error
}

func (stub *routeReadinessGraphs) GetPublishedGoalGraphExact(
	_ context.Context,
	goalCode string,
	goalVersion string,
	graphVersion string,
) (domain.GoalGraph, error) {
	stub.calls++
	if stub.err != nil {
		return domain.GoalGraph{}, stub.err
	}
	return domain.GoalGraph{
		Goal: domain.LearningGoal{Code: goalCode, Version: goalVersion, GraphVersion: graphVersion, Title: "Основы программирования"},
		Targets: []domain.LearningTarget{{
			Ref: domain.TargetRef{Type: domain.TargetConcept, Key: "programming.execution-state", Version: "v1"}, Title: "Execution",
			ModuleCode: "module", ModuleTitle: "Module", SectionCode: "section", SectionTitle: "Section",
			LessonCode: "lesson", LessonTitle: "Lesson",
		}},
	}, nil
}
